E2936

The constraint-layout type is named `Layout`, not `LayoutHandle`

What

The constraint-layout type is named `Layout`, not `LayoutHandle`

Why

One name for the solver/container value (I8).

Fix

Write `Layout` instead of `LayoutHandle`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2936: tests/ui/layout_handle_retired.stderr.

  2 | fn takes(h: LayoutHandle) {
    |             ^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `Layout` is the solver/container value constructed by `name :: Layout.{ … }`
 Fix: write `Layout` instead of `LayoutHandle`
